Name: Renny's Dog
Author: renjaminnifer
Description:
[center]﻿Want a weird mix of pekingnese, poodle, and terrier? Well here ya go!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/M4tSCKx.png[/img]﻿[/center][center](Dog inspecting a stupid shrine my qpp made)

This mod replaces the normal dog with mine! She's a beautiful baby and I've decided to share her all with you!﻿

[b]Installation:[/b]
-Download the latest version of SMAPI (in requirements)
-Download latest version of Content Patcher (in requirements)
-Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods

[b]Note:[/b] Yes I know there are some odd pixels here and there, and I'm gonna fix them very soon﻿
